Published

updated

Sam Stevenson

Associate News Editor

With two months to go until Americans vote in the 2026 midterm elections, new polling shows President Donald Trump facing a political landscape that has deteriorated significantly since the start of his second term.

The data comes from Civiqs' rolling online tracking poll of registered voters. [...] A Newsweek analysis compares Trump's approval rating on August 31, 2026, with where it stood when he returned to office on January 20, 2025, with net approval calculated as approve minus disapprove.

Jennifer Lindahl Bonnie Bolden Fernando Cervantes Jr.

Montgomery Advertiser

Updated Sept. 3, 2026, 1:50 p.m. CT

President Donald Trump’s approval rating among Alabama voters has slipped in recent weeks, according to the latest Civiqs polling, even as he continues to hold a positive overall rating in the state. Gender: Roughly two-thirds of women (70%) disapprove of Trump's performance. Men lean unfavorable toward Trump, with 60% disapproving and 35% approving.

Age: Roughly two-thirds of voters aged 18-34 (74%) disapprove of Trump's performance, followed by 70% of 35-49-year-olds, 59% of 50-64-year-olds and 58% of those 65 and older. [...] The poll, released on Aug. 17, found that only 33% of Americans approved of Trump’s performance, down 2 percentage points from another Reuters/Ipsos poll from earlier this month.

The Reuters/Ipsos poll was conducted Aug. 14-17 among 1,166 U.S. adults. The poll's margin of error was plus or minus 3 percentage points.
